gaps.term: q does not divide any numerator or denominator
gaps.quote: So $q$ divides no numerator or denominator of the finitely many matrices used.
gaps.note: The page presents this as following from the requirement that q must not divide v, but that requirement only constrains one denominator. The page does not say which matrices are 'the finitely many matrices used', why there are finitely many, or why q can be chosen to avoid all their numerators and denominators (including those of the inverses E_1^{-1} and E_2^{-1}).

gaps.quote: Per wire, the interchanges are fewer than $m$
